quest.title: Leisurely Chatter
quest.description: Paimon has a sudden yearning for the quirky stories told by Cloud Retainer. Go to Mt. Aocang to see this adeptus, with whom you are quite familiar.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x575, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: It is just as one expected. The owner of Wanmin Restaurant is indeed a most reasonable and accommodating human.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Still, the work here entails dealing with quite a varied group of people. Has this been difficult for you, Shenhe?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It's been manageable so far. I sometimes run into strange people, but I have figured out a way to deal with them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like you've been making progress! So by "dealing with them," you mean...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: First, I try to talk sense into them. If that doesn't work, I threaten them with violence. At this point, they usually decide they are in favor of a civil conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... How should Paimon put this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds reasonable enough...?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: A sensible plan. One is gladdened to see you integrate so well into human society.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: And you, Master? How have you been?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Simply marvelous! Though Mt. Aocang has scarcely enjoyed your presence recently, one has hardly found the pleasure of one's own company to be lacking.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I see... Just as expected of Master.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmph... Hmph!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What she means to say is, she actually misses the two of you a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I have missed Master quite a bit, too. Even though work has been busy lately, I've already had a conversation with Chef Mao about taking some time off soon to visit Master.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: You did? Ahem, do make note of such matters in your letters in the future. There is hardly a need to keep one in suspense.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, her mood shot up just like that...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: By the way... Master, since you are in Liyue Harbor, have you had the chance to visit Ganyu?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Indeed. She is similarly preoccupied with her work. There was time only to exchange a few simple pleasantries.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ganyu told us the story of Cloud Retainer's name! It was amazing — we never knew how powerful she was before!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I see. In that case, allow me to also share a story about Master's past.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Oh?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Is that a problem, Master? I believe this to be a good topic of conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: No, not a problem... one was simply caught off guard. But no matter. Please, proceed — one is most curious to see how much of one's own conversational prowess you possess.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Master once participated in a race against Moon Carver. After Moon Carver lost, he insisted that Master's ability to fly gave her a natural edge in such a contest.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: In response, Master agreed to forgo flying in return for being able to use one of her devices in the race. Moon Carver accepted, only to find Master with a brand-new device on the day of the contest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So what kind of device was it?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It was a mechanical vehicle made out of iron. What was it called again... An "Electro-Powered Bicycle"?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: You refer to the "Bi-Cyclical Thunderflash-Mobile." One spent forty-nine days conceptualizing and crafting it. It need only be infused with adeptal energy, and it can cover thousands of miles in one day.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: It boggles the mind why Moon Carver ever supposed he might best me in a contest of locomotion. Though he sprinted with all his might, he could barely keep up.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Alas, the one flaw of my mechanism lay in its weakness against mountainous terrain. One was thwarted mere seconds from victory, when it was thrown off course and failed to make it across the final stretch... Truly a most unfortunate turn of events... Anyway, do go on, Shenhe.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Master, that was the end of that story.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Is that so? *sigh* With you gone, one has seldom felt the desire to call upon those old fossils for another contest. What is a race without spectators, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Have you been lonely, Master?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Lonely? Hah, at one's age, entire human generations come and go in the blink of an eye. Even one's own self-directed musings can span several days and nights.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Tis a most foreign sentiment. The mere mention of it is preposterous.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Mmm? What is the reason for that look upon your face?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's nothing! It's just... Well, Paimon gained a lot of respect for you after listening to that story of you summoning the rain and everything. But... all it took was a few words out of your mouth, and it's like you're back to being that illuminated bird again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's just a little bit confused... which one of the two is the real Cloud Retainer?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: To me, they are both Master. One is the Master that's widely revered by the people, while the other is the Master that I respect and adore.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hah, one finds oneself exalted yet again with sweet words of praise and flattery of a most extravagant nature. You chose to exalt one with your words, yet you refuse to grace Mt. Aocang with your presence for any extended period of time. One would almost question the sincerity of your estimations.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: That is not to say that your words paint an inaccurate picture. One has always lived by a single ideal: eschew all action and abide by no rule. One does as one pleases and speaks as one pleases. Others may critique or praise as they see fit, yet one places little weight in such judgments.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She got like, what, two sentences of flattery from her disciple, and it's as if her ego is about to burst...

dialogues.speaker: Baotai
dialogues.text: Do you have any empty tables?

dialogues.speaker: Dixin
dialogues.text: Hey there! Could we get another Fish Stew?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: ...I'm hearing more guests come in. I should get back to work.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Good luck with the lunchtime rush, Shenhe!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Mhm hmm. I'll try my best.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here we are! Right outside her place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you still remember the first time we came here? We even brought offerings and everything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And when we told her that Rex Lapis had been assassinated, she immediately threatened to "squash Liyue Harbor"! Paimon thought she'd be impossible to get along with, but now that we've spent some more time together, she's really not like that at all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We probably don't need to bring any offerings now that we've gotten to know her pretty well, right? Still, Paimon's got some snacks around here somewhere, so if she really wants something, we can just use that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh? {NICKNAME}? Did something catch your eye?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, what a pretty lady! Is she also here to visit Cloud Retainer?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It seems like she could also be a powerful adeptus.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, you're right... All it takes is one look and you can tell she's someone special! As expected of that bird lady, really. She must have a whole bunch of adepti friends from all over the country!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, but... If we're both friends of Cloud Retainer, then we're basically friends by association, right? Want to go up to her and say hello?

choices.text: Who knew you were such a social butterfly, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Helping you make more connections is a part of Paimon's job as your reliable guide. Paimon's got this!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: H—Hello!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Um... Paimon is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—Ahem... Paimon doesn't think we've met, but we're also friends of Cloud Retainer. May we have the pleasure of learning your name, Madame Adeptus?
You two...
What is this tomfoolery? Has this shift in form so clouded your eyes that you no longer recognize one anymore?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, you're...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Cloud Retainer?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!? You're the illuminated bird? But you look human! How did that happen?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Donning human form is scarcely any test of one's abilities. As for your confusion, one merely had no reason to indulge such inclinations before.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So uh... you're indulging now because...?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Well... One has made plans to pay a visit to some disciples at Liyue Harbor. Taking on a human form for such a trip is simply a way to make matters less conspicuous.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You, worrying about keeping a low profile? You're the one who likes to pop up out of nowhere all over the place. In fact, Paimon can think of several examples. Like last year, when you suddenly appeared on the top of a roof without any warning, or—

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Ahem...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (It feels like Cloud Retainer has her reasons, but doesn't want to discuss them too openly...)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I almost forgot. Paimon brought you some gifts!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Didn't we agree to not bring that up unless she asked?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Oh? So you have taken care to follow the proper rules of etiquette after all. Most commendable.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Cloud Retainer tries, but fails, to look indifferent as Paimon begrudgingly takes out her snacks...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... Well, this is all Paimon's got. You don't mind, right...?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One has never found oneself lacking in basic comforts. On the contrary, it is the gesture that one values above all else. So long as you've shown proper respect and consideration, the quantity or quality of the gift is but a trivial matter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh... That kinda makes Paimon feel a little guilty for trying to keep them for herself. Anyway, where were we before you reminded Paimon about the gifts?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Cloud Retainer said that she's going to visit some of her disciples.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, right! So by disciples, you must mean Ganyu and Shenhe! It's also been a while since we last saw them. Maybe we can come too!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One planned to extend the invitation even if you had not raised the matter yourself. Shenhe and Ganyu should be quite pleased to see you again.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: However... One would first inquire as to the reason behind your visit here. You have cause to seek one's company?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No reason in particular.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we just found ourselves missing you and wanted to see how you were doing! We were hoping you'd tell us one of your stories. Who knew we'd run into your human form while we were at it...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Is that so...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: If there are no urgent matters at hand, then let us make haste for Liyue Harbor. Ganyu is likely still working at Yuehai Pavilion, so that shall be our first stop.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds great! Then let's all go to Liyue Harbor!

choices.text: (Just say everything in a nice, even tone!)
I'll leave the introductions to you!
Don't think we've ever seen her before...

talks.objective: Go to Yuehai Pavilion to meet Ganyu

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're almost at Yuehai Pavilion! Hey, do you think Ganyu will be shocked to see Cloud Retainer like this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess we have no idea if Shenhe and Ganyu have ever seen her in this form before... Wait, where did she go?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why are you just standing there, Cloud Retainer?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Quietly, now. One shall stay here. You two can go and meet with her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? But why? Isn't it better if we all go together?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hmph. If one were to proudly proclaim one's presence, Ganyu would surely profess herself otherwise unoccupied and drop everything to attend to one's visit. One fears that would only result in her staying up all night to make up for lost time.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One does not wish to trouble her. Conversing vicariously via you two shall suffice. Do remember to inquire as to her recent well-being. Again! Do not mention one's presence here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Fair enough, makes sense. Alright, then we'll just pass on your regards and—

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Cloud Retainer?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, busted!

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Is that lady someone you know, Ms. Ganyu?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: She is indeed. I'm sorry, Huixin, but could we delay the upcoming meeting for a little bit? I believe my schedule today is quite full. Although, perhaps I could move some work to later in the evening...

response.speaker: Huixin
response.text: Not to worry, Ms. Ganyu. I'll make the necessary arrangements right away.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Thank you, Huixin.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's been a while, Ganyu!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Greetings. What brings you here today? And Cloud Retainer, too... It's been quite some time since I last saw you in this form.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: You are quite mistaken. One is not acquainted with this Cloud Retainer of whom you speak. One is simply... a mere mortal passerby!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems she's not buying it!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ganyu saw right through her!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Ahem, that was... but a simple test. One did not expect you to be able to recognize one so easily, especially after so many years of only seeing one's other form.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Ganyu looks totally bewildered... She's thinking, "Why wouldn't I recognize you...? I used to see you every day... how bad do you think my memory is?")

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: But recognizing you is, uh... my responsibility as your disciple.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hah, an apt observation.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One was simply passing by while attending to some important business. One thought it would only be fitting to pay you a visit while in the area.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, Paimon wasn't aware of any important— Ohh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cloud Retainer's right! We've still got something suuuper important to do, so we can't stay here for too long today.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Is that so... but it's been so long since we last saw each other...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One simply desired to see you and had no intention of interrupting your work. A quick conversation should suffice for today — a more involved reunion should wait until you find yourself less occupied.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I understand. That should be fine...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: While one acknowledges the amount of work that you have to deal with every day, one must also remind you to rest. Though adepti blood flows through your veins, excessive exhaustion will still cause grave harm to your body.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Ah, it still makes one nostalgic to see you as you are now, respected and independent. When you were young, you oft begged one to cuddle you to sleep when you suffered from nightmares—

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: C—Cloud Retainer... Stop!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hm, if you insist. We are running short on time regardless, so one will refrain from going into each and every story. Why don't you continue your conversation? One shall simply stand by and listen.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You discuss some of your recent adventures with Ganyu...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Wow, you've been to so many new places since the last time we spoke. If you ever need anything, please just come find me at Yuehai Pavilion.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Also... Forgive me for my presumptuousness, Miss Cloud Retainer, but if you plan to continue appearing in this form, don't you think it'd be helpful to adopt a human name?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: A human name? Hmm, you raise a valid point. Considering the sheer extent of one's renown, "Cloud Retainer" is surely too recognizable as a name.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You really think so? ...Not that you're NOT famous, or anything, but... THAT famous?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hmph, you presume to know the extent of one's illustrious achievements? One would hardly think such a thing to be possible. Nevertheless, Ganyu's advice cannot be ignored. From this point on, when in public occasions, be sure to refer to one as "Xianyun."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Xianyun?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Ah, I assume that's a reference to the "Full Record of Pristine Pavilion."

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: An adeptus of years past would rise with the clouds and rest with the moon. They were enlightened and wise, free and unfettered. The writer referenced master's name to describe her carefree and spontaneous nature.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, that sounds super cool! Paimon feels like only the most powerful of adepti could rise with the clouds and rest with the moon!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Actually, those lines were originally written to describe Cloud Retainer herself...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!? Wait, so you're really that powerful?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: And what of it? Did you truly take one to be nothing more than a bird of bigger than average size?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: N—Not exactly...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: To be fair, Cloud Retainer rarely speaks of her past accomplishments. The tales of her past can only be found in ancient texts.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: It is said that once, a long, long time ago, there was a severe drought in Liyue. Left with no choice, many people left their homes, while others spent day and night praying to the adepti.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Although I did not live through such tragedy, simply reading about it is enough to gain a visceral understanding of all the pain and desperation during that time.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: On top of the drought, a noxious gas also began to spread through the land. If not for Cloud Retainer's efforts, much of Liyue would be nothing more than a barren wasteland today.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: The books had this to say about what happened:

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: "Upon arrival, the adeptus borrowed the wind to retain the clouds. Immediately, the clouds gathered together, and abundant rain burst forth from the heavens. Drought and plague were both driven away, and the people were saved."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woah! That's incredible!

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Mortal records add embellishments to dramatize past events. One did merely what one ought. And even if one had not interceded, the other adepti would surely have stepped in to help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even so... you stopped an entire drought! Can you really control the weather like the book said?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon suddenly has a lot more respect for you! Eh, so it was Paimon's bad for calling you "illuminated bird" before. You're not too mad, are you?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: How laughable. A name is but a simple label we carry with us on our journey through the world. Why would one be offended by such a trivial matter?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew... That's a relief... In that case, Paimon will continue to call you whatever feels right in the moment, hehe.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Well, that is quite enough ancient history for now. Ganyu, have you had word from Shenhe?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: One has heard that she procured a job recently. Have you any thoughts on her workplace? And what, pray tell, of her monthly remuneration?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Moreover, does she find herself overly inundated with work? Is she allowed time off during Lantern Rite?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That is a lot of questions!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: There is no cause for concern, Cloud Retainer. I introduced Shenhe to her employer personally.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Wanmin Restaurant's business has been booming recently, so with Chef Mao being swamped with customers, and Xiangling still often out in search of new recipes, I introduced Shenhe to staff the restaurant.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: I see. Most excellent indeed. One has had the pleasure of being introduced to that family. Xiangling is kind and astute, while her father is loyal and reliable. One has no cause to believe that they will make Shenhe's work difficult.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: ...Now, it is almost time to partake in the victuals of noon. One shall visit Wanmin Restaurant in person, and see how Shenhe is doing.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Huh? But didn't you just say that you had something important to do...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Can that wait until after we've eaten?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: You may return to your work, Ganyu. One shall see to this matter on one's own. There will be many an occasion to dine together in the future. One is certain the opportunity shall present itself most readily.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: #Of course, Cloud Retainer. Please take care. {NICKNAME}, Paimon — I'll see you some other time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: See you around, Ganyu!

choices.text: (That's totally what Paimon had in mind...)

talks.objective: Go to Wanmin Restaurant to see Shenhe

dialogues.speaker: Wenliu
dialogues.text: You get what I'm saying, right?

dialogues.speaker: Qingji
dialogues.text: Yeah, how can I not? Not even fine food is enough to distract from the presence of a fine lady.

dialogues.speaker: Wenliu
dialogues.text: I'm far more interested in getting her details than ordering any dishes. Hey, how about you ask her?

dialogues.speaker: Qingji
dialogues.text: You do it.

dialogues.speaker: Wenliu
dialogues.text: Nonono, I think you should... Wait, she's coming!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: What can I get for you today?

dialogues.speaker: Qingji
dialogues.text: Greetings, Miss. I was just wondering... If you'd be willing to—

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: What would you like to order?

dialogues.speaker: Qingji
dialogues.text: Eek!

dialogues.speaker: Wenliu
dialogues.text: Two servings of Mora Meat to go. ...Good chat, bye!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shenhe!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Welcome. It's been a while. May I take your order?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't welcome us as guests and greet us as old friends in the same line! It's weird!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's been a while, Shenhe.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Mmm.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: And this is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, this is Ms. Xianyun!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: ...Master?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hah, one does not recall ever revealing this form to you before. How were you able to ascertain one's true identity with such ease?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I've trained and lived with Master for more than ten years. I would recognize you no matter what form you take.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: *gasp* You...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Is something the matter, Master?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hardly, hardly. One simply learned of your employment from your letter and came to check on your well-being.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And check out the great food, too!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Indeed, it is almost lunch time... My apologies. I'm still on the clock, and can't talk for very long.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: #Well, if it isn't {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Are you here for Shenhe?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: The lunch rush isn't in yet, Shenhe, so I've got things covered for now.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Go ahead, sit down and enjoy some time with your friends. I'll let you know if things pick up.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Thank you, Chef Mao.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As more and more guests begin to trickle in, Paimon takes the opportunity to order a whole array of delicious dishes...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So much yummy food! Paimon's gonna feast!

choices.text: Can you eat this kind of food, Cloud Retainer?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: One is fond of all kinds of delicacies and delights in a multitude of flavors.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: The dishes here demonstrate no shortage of culinary skill. Their unique flavor profile has left one more than satisfied. In fact, one has been struck by quite the fit of inspiration. One has already begun to conceptualize the next generation of supreme cuisine machines.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Everything's so tasty... A bit too hot at times, but still super tasty...

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: I'm sorry, Miss, but our tables are full.
Shall we try somewhere else, Granny?
But it smells so delightful... Can we really not eat here? My poor legs can't go on for much longer.

response.speaker: Chef Mao
response.text: Well... You could always check with some of the other guests and see if anyone's happy to share a table?
Okay. I'll ask around.
Excuse me, would you mind letting us share a table with you? There are no empty tables left, so...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, well Paimon doesn't mind! What about you guys?

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Great! Thanks so much. My name is Shuyu, and this is my granny, Yuandai.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Granny?

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Yep. Is there something wrong with that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no, Paimon's just a bit surprised. She looks so young...

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Hehe, yeah, a lot of people compliment Granny on her youthful looks. But she's actually much older than she appears.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Granny? Why don't you take a seat? C'mon, it's not polite to stare...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Have we met before?

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: No...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Tis a fated meeting then. Please, take a seat.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: What would you like to eat, Granny? I can order for you.

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: I want... braised earthworms. They always pop up out of the ground after a rainstorm...

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: No, no, not this again! Granny, there's no braised earthworms on the menu.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Braised earthworms? Well, that sounds weird... Do people actually eat that?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Can't hurt to ask...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, that's what Paimon was thinking, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Need any help?

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Help? ... Oh, do you mean with Granny?

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Thanks, it's nice of you to offer. Granny has pretty bad dementia, so her memory's getting worse all the time. She's always saying things that sound kinda confusing.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Actually, her memory's been bad ever since I was little. But it's gotten so bad lately that I even have to remind her who I am every morning.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What about your parents?

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: They died young. It's just me and Granny now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, um...

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Ah, but it's okay, don't feel bad. Granny loves me a lot, and I love her a lot too. Sure, it's hard at times, but you just gotta make the best of the life you've got.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow. You're really tough for your age, kid!

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: You're too kind.

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: And me? What about me?

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: You're tough too, Granny. Plus, you're really gentle and you're always there for me.

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: Yes, and it's hardly as if I forget everything! I still remember the important things. Uhh... Wait, what was that really important thing again?

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: Ah, I remember now. It was a dream. I had a dream, where everything was dark. Someone was standing in front of me... She told me to come and find her — and that once I'd found her, I would be free.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Huh? That sounds super important... but how come you've never told me about it before?

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: It was just a dream, so I forgot about it. But I'm in a good mood now, and somehow I remembered it again.

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: Ah... You know, I believe I've had this dream a great many times. But just how many times have I had it? Now that, I do not remember...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so you have a recurring dream where someone's talking to you? That sounds spooky! Does that mean... You're possessed?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Unlikely. Her eyes are clear, and her breathing remains calm and level. One sees no signs of possession.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you sure?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Who do you take me for? Is one not an adept— Ahem, am I not an expert?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, you're right, Paimon almost forgot, you're the expert... In that case... Do you still remember what the person in your dreams looked like, Granny?

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: Not anymore. Although, I have a sense that she looked rather like... me, but not as I am now. My younger self.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: A younger version of Granny?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is just getting weirder and weirder! What is going on here?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: As one said, fate must have brought us together. You may leave this situation to me.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Are you sure? Umm... So, what are your names?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's Paimon!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #I'm {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Just Xianyun is fine.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Thank you all so much for offering to help! But first... I'm sorry for asking, but, um... How do you want us to pay you back?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, we don't need any payment for this.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We're just curious about your situation, and want to help if we can.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Th—Thank you so much!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're welcome! But Ms. Xianyun, what exactly can we do to help out this Granny?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All we have to go off of is that dream. Where do we start?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: That is elementary. Since her dreams portray her younger self, then we shall retrace the steps of her youth. Once we have revisited those places, her memories will likely return.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, sounds like a plan. So Granny, do you remember which places you went to when you were young?

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: Why, of course I do! The heavens above, the earth below, the wispy clouds, and the emerald mountain streams...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay... Taking that as a no.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: I... might have an idea.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: Once, when I was really little, my dad told me that Granny used to be a martial artist heroine who saved loads of people from a disaster.

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: If it's true, then maybe they wrote about it in the history books, or something...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A martial arts heroine? Hmm... Oh! Xingqiu knows tons about Liyue's chivalric traditions. If anyone knows about the heroes of the past, it's him. Let's go find him at the Feiyun Commerce Guild!

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: Are you leaving already? But I'm still hungry...

response.speaker: Shuyu
response.text: I'll go order some food, Granny. If there's nothing on the menu that you especially want, I'll just get a few different things.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: #It seems we must part ways for now. {NICKNAME} and Paimon are bound for the Feiyun Commerce Guild, while Yuandai and Shuyu shall remain here and partake of their lunch. As for myself... I have matters to discuss with Streetward Rambler.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Streetward Rambler... Oh! You mean Madame Ping?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Precisely. Let us meet at Yujing Terrace once you are ready.

choices.text: As long as you don't mind our chatter.
Is the food to your taste, Cloud Retainer?

dialogues.speaker: Mechanism on the table
dialogues.text: (An elegantly assembled mysterious mechanism. For some reason, it is hard to keep your eyes off of it.)

dialogues.speaker: Mechanism on the table
dialogues.text: (It appears to be one of Cloud Retainer's new inventions, but it's hard to tell what it could be used for.)

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: I wonder where Xiangling's run off to this time...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: If you bump into her, please let her know that a new shipment of spices has come in, so it'd be nice if she could come home and take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've been to so many places lately! What do you say we take a day off from adventuring and just find somewhere nice to relax?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon think, where are some nice places we could go... Oh, why don't we pay Cloud Retainer a visit at Mt. Aocang?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's been a while since we last saw that illuminated bird! She's always the one popping up out of nowhere and scaring us half to death, so let's surprise her this time!

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: *sigh* Ganyu has been quite busy with work as of late. One can count on one talon the number of times she returns to Mt. Aocang each year.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Shenhe has also secured employment recently. In her correspondence with me, she wrote that she shall have "no need to return for the foreseeable future."

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Hmph! Did they think one was so easily mollified? One shall investigate everything with one's own eyes, and decide for oneself if their living conditions are satisfactory!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... Paimon was pretty quick on the uptake there, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As soon as you mentioned important business to attend to, Paimon realized that you were just looking to cut the conversation short, and not take too much of Ganyu's time! Is Paimon right?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: No, in fact, it was not an excuse. One is indeed visiting Liyue Harbor for an important purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, for real?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: The moment is not yet upon us. Still, the truth will be revealed to you in time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... She really seems to be playing up the whole mysterious adeptus thing right now... Is it because we just heard that cool story about her powers?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As more and more guests begin to trickle in, Paimon takes the opportunity to order a whole array of delicious dishes...

dialogues.speaker: Baotai
dialogues.text: I've always wanted to try this place...

dialogues.speaker: Dixin
dialogues.text: For this price, the food is unbelievable!

dialogues.speaker: Wenliu
dialogues.text: Everyone, please eat to your hearts' content! Today is my treat.
